title: The Broken Crown
author: C. M. Voss
blurb: Zephyrine Nystrom, an exiled storm-caller, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
